sql:
SELECT 
  c."name", 
  c."email", 
  c."mobile", 
  c."address", 
  SUM(ms."total_amount") AS "Total Sales"
FROM "customers" c
JOIN "master_sale" ms ON c."id" = ms."customer_id"
WHERE c."name" ILIKE '%Bismillah%'
GROUP BY c."name", c."email", c."mobile", c."address"
ORDER BY "Total Sales" DESC;
